description: Grants permission to transcribe audio submitted by the creator. Transcription is treated as a derivative and subject to the same consent terms as audio generation.
notes: STT cannot execute without a valid consent record for scope=speech_to_text.
Transcripts must not be stored beyond the creator-controlled retention period.
Sharing a transcript requires an explicit visibility grant from the creator.
Speech-to-text is generation. It is never always-on surveillance.
